name: Neomorphic Egg Sacs

tactics: Smoke repels them and fire kills them; keep orifices and wounds covered.

signatureAttacks.text: 10 Base Dice, Damage 1; a hit grapples and disorients (lose next slow action), and next action it squeezes for another 10 dice, Damage 1.

special: Ambush Predator: in its own territory, prey get -2 OBSERVATION against it in stealth mode.
tactics: Confuse it with pollen, pollutants, or the scent of a rival lion worm.

name: Tanakan Scorpionid

signatureAttacks.name: Retreat
signatureAttacks.text: Decides the fight isn't worth it and flees.

signatureAttacks.name: Pinned Down
signatureAttacks.text: 10 Base Dice, Damage 1; a hit knocks the target prone, makes them drop held items and forces a Panic Roll.

signatureAttacks.name: Pincer Grab
signatureAttacks.text: 8 Base Dice, Damage 1; a hit grapples (opposed CLOSE COMBAT vs 8 to escape) and next initiative it uses Tail Strike; underwater it also drags the victim a zone deeper (drowning).

signatureAttacks.name: Flailing Strike
signatureAttacks.text: 8 Base Dice, Damage 1; a hit flings the victim into the next zone with an immediate critical injury, prone and disarmed.

signatureAttacks.name: Tail Strike
signatureAttacks.text: 10 Base Dice, Damage 1; damage poisons the victim, a disease with Virulence 9.

signatureAttacks.name: Immobilize
signatureAttacks.text: 8 Base Dice, Damage 2 at the legs; damage inflicts critical injury #35.

special: Armor is 3 against bullets. In water: Speed 3, Mobility 10, Observation 10, and it can sprint (slow action, two zones) when starting in water.
tactics: Shells stop knives but not bullets.

name: Biodrone (Xenomorph XX121B)

signatureAttacks.name: Hypnotizing Gaze
signatureAttacks.text: The victim is transfixed: +1 Stress and an immediate Panic Roll.

signatureAttacks.name: Playing With Its Prey
signatureAttacks.text: Knocks the victim down and makes them drop held items, no damage; +1 Stress and a Panic Roll.

signatureAttacks.name: Deadly Grab
signatureAttacks.text: 10 Base Dice, Damage 1. On a hit drags the victim to a neighboring zone: prone, drops items, Panic Roll.

signatureAttacks.name: Ready to Kill
signatureAttacks.text: 10 Base Dice; on a hit the victim is grabbed and must win opposed CLOSE COMBAT vs 10 dice to break free. Victim and friends in the zone make Panic Rolls; next initiative it uses Headbite unless freed.

signatureAttacks.name: Capture for the Hive
signatureAttacks.text: Venom tail, 10 Base Dice; any damage is reduced to 1 and paralysis follows: STAMINA successes = Rounds before falling unconscious for a Shift. Cured by adrenaline (MEDICAL AID with a medkit).

signatureAttacks.name: Headbite
signatureAttacks.text: Inner jaws, 9 Base Dice, Damage 2. Any damage means critical injury #64 (death), unless the GM keeps the victim alive for ovomorphing.

special: XX121 traits: Acid Splash when wounded by blood-drawing damage (rating + damage taken in Base Dice, Damage 1, eats 1 armor per success, keeps burning at half dice each Round); sprint as a slow action (two zones, or straight to ENGAGED) except Stage I; immune to vacuum and cold; ignores the first 10 Rads; needs no air; invisible to IR/thermal; falling damage is meters/4 minus armor. Gene-locked at Stage IV (no Queens) and meant to die after six days; when it collapses it has a 50% chance to get back up ('Reborn', no expiry). Still reproduces by ovomorphing captives.
tactics: Keep shooting after it falls.
note: Uses the Stage IV Drone attack table (CRB p309).

name: Goreburster (Xenomorph XX121AB)

signatureAttacks.name: Bodyslam
signatureAttacks.text: Knocks the target prone and flees two zones into a duct, leaving a toxic pink trail (Virulence 6 on contact).

signatureAttacks.name: Terrorizing Hiss
signatureAttacks.text: Immediate Panic Roll.

signatureAttacks.name: Head Attack
signatureAttacks.text: 9 Base Dice, Damage 2; a hit knocks prone; damage inflicts critical injury #15, #31 or #34 (equal odds) and a Panic Roll.

signatureAttacks.name: Suffocation
signatureAttacks.text: 10 Base Dice, Damage 1; a hit grapples and drowns the victim (Panic Roll); escaping needs CLOSE COMBAT vs its 10 dice; it keeps grappling until the victim is Broken.

signatureAttacks.name: Disembowelment
signatureAttacks.text: 8 Base Dice, Damage 1; damage inflicts critical injury #46 and a Panic Roll; if not removed by next Round it inflicts #63 (death).

special: XX121 traits: Acid Splash when wounded by blood-drawing damage (rating + damage taken in Base Dice, Damage 1, eats 1 armor per success, keeps burning at half dice each Round); sprint as a slow action (two zones, or straight to ENGAGED) except Stage I; immune to vacuum and cold; ignores the first 10 Rads; needs no air; invisible to IR/thermal; falling damage is meters/4 minus armor. After a damaging hit the victim rolls Sickness vs Virulence 6 every Turn or explodes, until sterilized with UV (AutoDoc, medpod, etc.). Does not mature; dies on its own after a Shift or two.
tactics: Hazmat gear; trap it or wait it out.

name: Vitiate 'Afflicted' (Anathema Stage I)
special: Infected human: paranoia, delirium, endless tears (+1 Stress), worms visible in the eyes late in the stage. Touching one without a hazmat/compression suit: Sickness Roll vs Virulence 4. Each Shift roll vs Virulence 8 or advance to Stage II.
tactics: Isolation; avoid the contagious eye worms.

name: Ague 'Febrile' (Anathema Stage II)

signatureAttacks.name: Enthralling Gaze
signatureAttacks.text: Fast action vs a human in SHORT range: WITS roll (attribute only) or lose next fast and slow action; victim and friendly PCs in SHORT range gain +1 Stress.

special: Feverish, bleeding internally, black eyes, spreading veins (+1 Stress). Contact without protection: Sickness Roll vs Virulence 6. After a Shift, roll vs Virulence 8: success = Stage III, failure = Stage IV.
tactics: Fire, or nuke it from orbit.

name: Lusus 'Freak' (Anathema Stage III)

signatureAttacks.name: Horrific Howl
signatureAttacks.text: PCs in SHORT range make Panic Rolls.

signatureAttacks.name: Fist Strike
signatureAttacks.text: 10 Base Dice, Damage 1.

signatureAttacks.name: Eye Gouge
signatureAttacks.text: 7 Base Dice, Damage 1; damage inflicts critical injury #34 and a Panic Roll.

signatureAttacks.name: Beat Down
signatureAttacks.text: 8 Base Dice, Damage 1; a hit knocks down and disarms (Panic Roll), followed by a bonus pummeling of 10 Base Dice, Damage 2.

signatureAttacks.name: Bearhug
signatureAttacks.text: 8 Base Dice, Damage 1; damage inflicts critical injury #56 and a Panic Roll.

signatureAttacks.name: Black Vomit
signatureAttacks.text: Sickness Roll vs Virulence 10 or become an Anathema; suited victims first make a CLOSE COMBAT roll to keep their visor on.

special: Rage-driven mutant that attacks all life but can use simple tools. Unprotected contact: Sickness Roll vs Virulence 7. Progresses to Stage IV within a Shift or two.
tactics: Treat as a full creature; burn it.

name: Nocuous 'Terminal' (Anathema Stage IV)
special: Disintegrating body loses 1 Health per Round and dies at zero (no Death Roll), releasing the accelerant into the air: unprotected people in the same zone roll Sickness vs Virulence 8, adjacent zone vs 4.
tactics: Too late: hold your breath, get indoors, bring incinerators.

name: Arctura

signatureAttacks.name: Echolocation
signatureAttacks.text: +1 to its next roll here (max 6); PCs up to LONG range gain +1 Stress.

signatureAttacks.name: Ultrasonic Challenge
signatureAttacks.text: Everyone in SHORT range passes STAMINA (no action) or is stunned and loses their next action; +1 Stress.

signatureAttacks.name: Pummel Attack
signatureAttacks.text: 6 Base Dice, Damage 1; a hit knocks down and disarms (Panic Roll), then a bonus pummel of 6 Base Dice, Damage 2.

signatureAttacks.name: Not the Face
signatureAttacks.text: 6 Base Dice, Damage 1; damage means a Panic Roll and critical injury #31.

signatureAttacks.name: Rend Limb From Limb
signatureAttacks.text: 5 Base Dice, Damage 1; damage inflicts critical injury #54 and a Panic Roll.

signatureAttacks.name: Savage Bite
signatureAttacks.text: 6 Base Dice, Damage 1; damage inflicts critical injury #61 and a Panic Roll.

special: Blind ape-like predator of Arcturus that hunts by sonar.

name: Running Flatfish

signatureAttacks.name: Poison Bite
signatureAttacks.text: 5 Base Dice, Damage 1; a hit forces a Sickness Roll vs Virulence 6, rolled every Turn instead of every Shift.

special: Two-meter millipede-like fish that swims and crawls along bulkheads and ceilings. No Speed given in the book.

name: Arcturian Grain Parasites

stats.armor: When clustered, immune to all but fire, electricity and pesticides

signatureAttacks.name: Swarming Bites
signatureAttacks.text: Attack en masse with 6 Base Dice, Damage 1, and smother a target in their hundreds (asphyxiation rules).

special: Cluster rules: size and Speed equal the zones covered; Health 3 per zone; disperses at zero.

name: Hungry Tendril

signatureAttacks.name: Snare
signatureAttacks.text: Grapple with 6 Base Dice, no damage; the victim must win opposed CLOSE COMBAT vs 6 dice or be dragged under to drown.

special: Seabed tendrils in Pandora's shallows that bury themselves at low tide.

name: Norcomm Dzho 'Fighting Joe' Automaton
special: UPP-repurposed Seegson Working Joe slaved to a 1VAN/3 mainframe (which can lend its skills for a Round). Talent: Pack Mule. Substandard components: every critical injury rolls twice on the synthetic table.
tactics: Overwhelm the controlling computer.

name: USCMC Berserker (MOX Exowarrior)
special: Convict hard-wired into a MOX exosuit (in-suit skill values shown; base Stamina 3, Close Combat 2, Ranged Combat 4). Talents: Tough, Killer, Rapid Fire. Armed with a 25mm gatling gun, M240, stun baton, U1 launcher, U4 launcher with QTC and a Damage 2 claw. The typical Berserker on ACM p170 has STR 5 and Health 7.
tactics: Unstable and liable to turn on friendlies; subdue it, lure it away or destroy it.

name: Colonial Marshal
gear: Folding knife, Armat 12 gauge pump shotgun, M4A3 pistol, handcuffs, flashlight.

name: Corporate Exec
gear: Penlight, Swiss army knife, $2000 bribe money, PDT, voice recorder.

name: Corporate Killer
gear: M42A scope rifle, hunting knife, medkit, flashlight, garotte, gag, tie-wraps, binoculars.

name: Cultist
gear: Two hunting knives, twelve doses of recreational drugs, .357 Magnum.

gear: M4A3 pistol, medkit, flashlight, pulse rifle, 4 grenades, combat knife.

gear: Geology kit, climbing gear, flashlight, multi-tool, digital camera, sample container.

gear: Bio-testing kit, survival knife, pocket survival kit, digital camera, electronic repair kit, voice recorder, sample case.

gear: Rugged flashlight, multi-tool, cutting tool, maintenance jack.

name: Pilot
gear: M4A3 pistol, binoculars, flashlight, pilot logbook, nav charts.

gear: Testing kit, climbing gear, flashlight, multi-tool, sample containers.

name: Frontier Marshals
gear: Folding knife, Armat 37A2 shotgun, M4A3 pistol, handcuffs, flashlight.

name: Convicted Killers
gear: Two shivs, cigarettes, a dose of street drugs.

name: Insurgents
gear: EVA pistol, AK-4047 or shotgun, Molotov cocktail.

name: Cult Fanatics
gear: Recreational drugs, X-stims, razor, pamphlets.

gear: Belt of 20 M40 grenades, X-stims, F903WE rifle, pocket knife.

gear: Kevlar armor, M41A, medkit, four grenades, flashlight.

gear: CCC5 suit, AK-104s suit gun, QSZ-203, flashlight, four grenades, combat knife.

gear: P-DAT, neuro visor. Every crit rolls twice on the synthetic table.
